selected_records.title: Army awards Anduril contract worth up to $1.8B over five years to expand NGC2

article.body:
Anduril Industries receives up to $1.8B contract from the Army to expand NGC2

The Army has awarded Anduril Industries a contract worth up to $1.8B over five years to expand the Next Generation Combat Vehicle-2 (NGC2) program. The contract will involve the development and production of advanced ground-based sensors and autonomous systems for the NGC2 program. The specific terms of the contract have not been disclosed.
